about_the_game:
Storyline:

  • In the game, you play as a veteran detective who accidentally stumbles into a mysterious otherworldly dimension—a terrifying realm hidden at the edge of reality. To survive, you must navigate this perilous world, from shadowy corridors to abandoned rooms, facing eerie chases and life-or-death battles against monstrous creatures. Each exploration will test your courage and wit. Only by completing missions in each realm can you gradually uncover the secrets of this dimension and find a way to escape. Upon finishing the final mission, you will face the ultimate choice: return to reality or be forever lost in this horrific realm.

Gameplay:

  • ​Trade & Progression: Collect valuable items within a time limit, trade them at designated locations, and meet the required transaction quota to advance.

  • ​Economy & Upgrades: Earn more coins to purchase advanced weapons and stat boosts in the in-game store.

  • ​Dynamic Levels: Each level features unique designs and different types of monsters.

  • ​Special Challenges: Encounter special stages with distinct mechanics.

​Horror Elements: Stay alert for strategically placed jump scares.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win7/win10
  • Processor: Intel i3-12100F \ AMD R5-5600​
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1650​ 4G \ AMD RX 6500 XT 4G
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win7/win10
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 \ AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2080 8GB \ AMD RX 6700 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 16 GB available space

short_description: "Realm" is an immersive FPS horror game developed with Unreal Engine 5. Players must search for valuable items or complete special tasks for the Lord of the Realm across different chambers, while confronting threats from monsters of various forms.
supported_languages:
English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Polish, Simplified Chinese*, Traditional Chinese*, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
*languages with full audio support
